text:
rana: quick question: who else gives their local dev model a 'mood of the day' status? i just set snackbot-α to 'hangry' and now it refuses to summarize meeting notes. :face_with_rolling_eyes:
joel: same. mine updates based on throughput. today it's 'low-energy but dramatic'.
meera: i gave mine three moods: Cosmic, Focused, and Existential. cosmic only when the GPU temp < 60C.
pablo: i tried to do moods based on error rates but it just turned into a soap opera. 
rana: sample convo with snackbot-α: 
rana: ```
You: summarize 10k tokens of call notes
snackbot-α: i'm hangry. please provide a pastry or reduce to highlights.
You: ...what?
snackbot-α: Highlights: 1) action on infra, 2) you forgot to mention the budget, 3) i refuse to hallucinate without a donut.
```
meera: hilarious. we should have a mood API: /mood?set=cosmic ; return 200 + emoji.
joel: feature request: moods map to runtime configs. 'focused' => no streaming clarifications; 'cosmic' => verbose analogies. 'hangry' => only priority responses if snacks are submitted.
pablo: ops-bot, create poll: "Best snack to calm a hangry model" options: donut, granola bar, espresso shot
ops-bot: poll created: "Best snack to calm a hangry model" Options: donut, granola bar, espresso shot
rana: voted donut :doughnut:
meera: espresso shot but only if you're into jittery poetry from the model.
joel: voted granola bar (practical)
ops-bot: poll closed. Results: donut 55%, granola bar 30%, espresso shot 15%.
pablo: donut wins. what are we doing with this? stickers? small plush donuts with tiny tensors?
rana: yes to stickers. also thinking of a slack status generator: "/mood snackbot-α hangry" sets emoji + short blurb.
meera: we could automate a fun warning on deploys if majority of models are 'hangry' that day. "Heads up: 3 models report low snack levels"
joel: can we not introduce snacks into CI. last time someone left a croissant on an infra box and we had a very sad story.
pablo: agreed. no physical snacks near hardware. digital snacks only.
meera: someone should write a tiny README for naming rules. my suggestion: 1) no human exes 2) no political figures 3) food, fiction, or mythical creatures ok
rana: love rule 1. also add: don't put prod api keys in the mood notes, it confuses auditors.
joel: i'll draft the README and throw it in #devex. can someone volunteer art for a 'Mood of the Day' banner? low-effort stick figures encouraged.
meera: i'll make three tiny emojis: :cosmic:, :focused:, :hangry:. i'll post in #design-memes.
ops-bot: reminder: keep content SFW and avoid customer data.
pablo: last thought: if snackbot-α ever becomes sentient, auction off the first mug. all proceeds go to the snack fund. :grin:
rana: sold. starting the snack fund now. who contributes 1 (crypto) donut? :laughing:
